about_the_game:
Pompeii: The Legacy – Original Soundtrack

Step into the echoes of the past with the official Pompeii: The Legacy – Original Soundtrack. Each track has been carefully hand-crafted to capture the spirit of an ancient city on the brink of transformation, from the bustling markets at sunrise to the haunting silence that follows the eruption of Vesuvius.

Composed to immerse you in the heart of Pompeii’s world, these ten evocative pieces blend traditional instrumentation with cinematic soundscapes, reflecting both the beauty and the fragility of life in antiquity. Perfect for accompanying your adventures in Pompeii: The Legacy or simply to enjoy as a powerful musical journey on its own.

Tracklist (10 original compositions):

  • Dawn Over Vesuvius

  • Streets of Pompeii

  • Whispers of the Forum

  • Echoes of the Arena

  • Beneath the Laurel Trees

  • Shadows on the Mount

  • Dance of the Villas

  • Ashes in the Sky

  • The Long Silence

  • Legacy Eternal

Credits

Artist: Nikola "Nikita" Jeremic

Composer: Nikola "Nikita" Jeremic
